text:
Brett Howden scored in four of five games in mid-October and then the goals stopped. He's pointless in six straight, but on 2.7 expected goals over that stretch, so the looks haven't gone anywhere. He just isn't converting them right now.

That's the honest picture of a bottom-six Vegas forward who has 5 goals in 18 games on 5.32 expected. Over the full season his finishing is right on schedule; it's the recent drought that stings, and Vegas has scored about four goals fewer than its chances deserve with him on the ice. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking from last season shows the kind of shooter he is: he gets 1.6 shots per 60 minutes off passes across the slot or from behind the net, and those go in about 25% of the time.

His burst speed sits in the 95th percentile, which explains why he keeps getting behind people. Our projection says 17 goals is the middle of his range. For a 2023 Cup winner earning his minutes on the third line, the drought looks like noise to us. Watch the next five games: if the shots keep coming from the slot, the goals follow.
headline: The chances are there for Howden
